Also sets `FLOCI_AZ_DOCKER_DOCKER_HOST` to `unix:///var/run/docker.sock` (the container-side path where the socket is always mounted) so Floci can connect to it.
items.returns: A reference to the `IResourceBuilder`1` for further configuration.

parameters.name: socketPath
parameters.description: Optional. Host path to the Docker socket (default: `/var/run/docker.sock`). Non-standard paths (e.g. Podman at `/run/user/1000/podman/podman.sock`) are bind-mounted to `/var/run/docker.sock` inside the container.
